subject: general
question:
What is the maximum value of a given item per kg out of the given years of the given table:-

 
 

 Year
 
 
Quantity

 
(in kg)

 
 
 
Value

 
(in Rs.)
solution:
**Given:**

 
 

 Year
 
 
Quantity

 
(in kg)

 
 
 
Value

 
(in Rs.)

 
 
 

 1993
 110
 230
 
 

 1994
 95
 210
 
 

 1995
 125
 340
 
 

 1996
 130
 430
 
 

**Calculation:**

⇒ In 1993, value of 110 kg of an item = Rs 230

⇒ Value of 1 kg item = (230)/(110) = 2.1 Rs

⇒ In 1994, value of 95 kg of an item = Rs 210

⇒ Value of 1 kg item = (210)/(95) = 2.21 Rs

⇒ In 1995, value of 125 kg of an item = Rs 340

⇒ Value of 1 kg item = (340)/(125) = 2.72 Rs

⇒ In 1996, value of 130 kg of an item = Rs 430

⇒ Value of 1 kg item = (430)/(130) = 3.3 Rs

**Therefore, the maximum value of a given item per kg out of given years is Rs 3.3.**
